name: routing
text:
# Routing
Mode standard. A call that names nothing uses perplexity/sonar with web search. tier works only in custom mode.
The mode is only a default. An explicit model is always used exactly as given, in every mode. depth (fast, low, medium) picks a Perplexity preset instead. depth, tier and model cannot be combined: pass one, or none for the default. perplexity_research is not routed: it always runs a preset.
Every ask and chat result has routing: mode, tier, model and selected_by (default, tier, depth or model).
